'''Kedorzha''' was a<ref name="TEA" /> terrestrial<ref name="Terrestrial" /> celestial body located in the [[Kedorzha system/Legends|Kedorzha system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Hestria system/Legends|Hestria system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Kedorzha was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the nearly blind [[Kedorzhan]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="TEA" /> members of which spoke the [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Kedorzhan (language)|same name]]<ref name="KOTORCG" /> and had traveled offworld by [[3964 BBY]].<ref name="KOTOR2">[[Knights of the Old Republic 2|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 2]]</ref> The species was eventually [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by [[House Garonnin]], one of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the Senex-Juvex, and many Kedorzhans were put to work in Garonnin [[Mining/Legends|mines]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kedorzha was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
